entries.q: What is Medipost AI?
entries.a: Medipost AI writes ready-to-publish content for your clinic's social media. You give it a short brief — your specialty, a topic and a tone — and it produces the post, caption, hashtags and a matching visual in about a minute.

entries.q: What kinds of content can I make?
entries.a: Single posts, carousels of 2 to 10 slides, 9:16 stories, reel scripts, awareness campaigns, festive greetings, and Template Studio posters. Template Studio needs Growth or Pro Clinic.

entries.q: Can I make posts in Hindi or another language?
entries.a: Yes. Pick your language in the Content Language dropdown in the brief — English, Hindi, Marathi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Gujarati, Punjabi or Malayalam. The text on the creative, the caption and the script are all written in that language.

entries.q: How do I make my first post?
entries.a: Three steps. Set up your Brand Kit — clinic name, specialty, colours and logo — so everything comes out on-brand. Then pick a format and fill in the brief: category, specialty, topic and tone. Then hit Generate, and tap 'Generate visual' to add an image.

entries.q: How do I set up my Brand Kit?
entries.a: Open the Brand Kit page and add your clinic name, doctor name, specialty, logo, brand colours, phone and website. You enter it once and it's applied to every creative you generate afterwards. You can change it any time.

entries.q: How many posts do I get each month?
entries.a: Starter includes 10 posts a month. Growth is ₹499 a month for 60 posts. Pro Clinic is ₹999 a month for 200 posts. Your allowance resets at the start of each billing period.

entries.q: I have posts left but can't generate images
entries.a: Your plan has a separate monthly allowance for AI visuals, so you can still have posts left while the visuals for this period are used up. Generating a visual for every slide of a carousel uses that allowance faster than a single post does. It resets at the start of your next billing period, and a higher plan comes with more.

entries.q: Does regenerating use another credit?
entries.a: Yes — each generation counts as one, including a regeneration of the same topic. If a generation fails, it's returned to you automatically, so you're only charged for content you actually receive.

entries.q: When does my monthly limit reset?
entries.a: At the start of each billing period — one month from when your current period began, not on the 1st of the calendar month. You can see your usage on the Subscription page.

entries.q: I've run out of generations
entries.a: You can wait for your billing period to reset, or move to a higher plan for more each month — Growth gives 60 posts, Pro Clinic gives 200. You can upgrade from the Subscription page.

entries.q: How does the ₹1 trial work?
entries.a: You pay ₹1 and get 7 days of the full Growth plan — 60 posts a month, all tones, Template Studio and no watermark. The ₹1 is a registration charge, not a subscription payment. One trial per account.

entries.q: It says my trial is already used
entries.a: Each account can take the ₹1 trial once, and the system has it recorded against yours. If that looks wrong, our team will check it — I'm passing this to them now.

entries.q: Will I be charged ₹499 after the trial?
entries.a: Yes. When the 7-day trial ends, ₹499 a month is charged automatically to the payment method you used and your Growth plan carries on without a break. If you'd rather not continue, cancel from the Subscription page before the trial ends and nothing further is charged.
entries.note: States the subscription as designed and sold. Team note, not for customers: recurring mandates were not live on the PayU merchant account as of 2026-11-06, so trials reaching day 8 before activation lapse rather than convert. Watch those accounts manually.

entries.q: I paid but my account still shows free
entries.a: Sorry about that — that shouldn't happen. I'm passing this to our team with your account details so they can activate your plan. A payment that completed is never lost.

entries.q: What payment methods can I use?
entries.a: Payments go through PayU, which accepts UPI, debit and credit cards, net banking and wallets.

entries.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
entries.a: Open the Subscription page and cancel from there. You keep access until the end of the period you've already paid for.

entries.q: Can I get a refund?
entries.a: Refunds are reviewed case by case by our team. I'm passing your message to them — tell me anything else that would help them understand what happened.

entries.q: I've been charged twice
entries.a: That needs looking at properly — I'm passing it to our team now so they can check both transactions and put it right.

entries.q: How do I get an invoice or receipt?
entries.a: Our team can send you a receipt for any payment. I'm passing this on — mention which payment you need it for.

entries.q: How do I upgrade my plan?
entries.a: Go to the Subscription page and choose Growth or Pro Clinic. The higher limits and features apply as soon as the payment goes through.

entries.q: I'm getting an error when I generate
entries.a: Try once more first — if the AI service was momentarily busy the second attempt usually works, and a failed generation doesn't cost you anything. If it keeps failing, tell me the exact message on screen and I'll pass it to the team.

entries.q: It says no active subscription found
entries.a: That means the system can't see a live plan on your account, usually a payment that didn't finish registering. I'm passing this to our team — it's quick for them to fix.

entries.q: The image isn't generating
entries.a: Two common reasons. If you've used your plan's monthly allowance for AI visuals, generating stops until your billing period resets. Otherwise the image service may have been briefly busy — try again, and a failed attempt doesn't cost you anything. If it still won't work, tell me what the screen says.

entries.q: My generated content has disappeared
entries.a: Everything you generate is saved automatically — open Content History, where you can search and filter by format. If something genuinely isn't there, tell me roughly when you made it and I'll pass it on.

entries.q: Where can I find my old posts?
entries.a: In Content History. Everything you've generated is saved there, with search and filtering by content type.

entries.q: How do I download my post?
entries.a: Use the Download button under the preview. Posts come out as 1080×1080 PNG, stories as 1080×1920, and for carousels you can download one slide or all of them at once.

entries.q: How do I remove the watermark?
entries.a: The watermark is on the free Starter plan. It's removed on Growth and Pro Clinic.

entries.q: Can Medipost post to Instagram directly?
entries.a: Not at the moment. You download the creative and copy the caption, then post it from your own account. Direct publishing isn't available yet.

entries.q: Why can't I choose a different tone?
entries.a: Starter writes in Standard tone and targets General Public only. Professional, Educational, Friendly and Motivational tones, and the other audiences, are part of Growth.

entries.q: Why can't I use Template Studio?
entries.a: Template Studio's ready-made poster designs are a Growth feature. You can browse the designs on Starter, but generating with them needs Growth or Pro Clinic.

entries.q: Why is it asking for a statistic and source?
entries.a: That's for the 'Did You Know?' category. Medipost will format a number for social media but never invents or changes one, so it asks you to supply the figure and where it came from — nothing unverified goes out under your clinic's name. Pick a different category if you don't want a statistic in the post.

entries.q: How many slides can a carousel have?
entries.a: Between 2 and 10. You set it with the slider in the brief before generating.

entries.q: Can I edit the content after generating?
entries.a: Yes. You can copy any section and change the wording, and in the studio panel you can adjust the theme, layout, fonts, colours and icons, then download the result.

entries.q: Can I manage more than one clinic?
entries.a: Multi-brand support is part of Pro Clinic. I'm passing this to our team so they can confirm exactly how it would work for your setup.

entries.q: Is the medical information accurate?
entries.a: Always review generated content before you publish it. Medipost drafts it for you, but you're the clinician and the post goes out under your name. For 'Did You Know?' posts it only ever uses the statistic and source you supply — it won't invent a number.

entries.q: Can I upload a patient's report or prescription?
entries.a: Please don't. Medipost is for marketing and patient-education content, not clinical records, and identifiable patient information shouldn't be entered anywhere in it. For anything patient-specific, use your clinical system.

entries.q: Can you tell me about a medicine or dosage?
entries.a: That's outside what Medipost does — it's a content tool for clinics, not a medicine or treatment reference. For anything about medicines, dosages or treatment, please go to a qualified pharmacist or clinician.

entries.q: Is my data safe?
entries.a: Your content isn't used to train AI models. Data is encrypted in transit, passwords are hashed, and your Brand Kit and generated content are visible only to your account. The full detail is in the Privacy Policy on the website.

entries.q: I want to delete my account
entries.a: Our team handles account deletion so it's done properly and completely. I'm passing this to them — they'll confirm with you before anything is removed.

entries.q: I think someone else is using my account
entries.a: Change your password straight away from the login page. I'm flagging this to our team now so they can check the account.

entries.q: I forgot my password
entries.a: Use 'Forgot password' on the login page and you'll get a reset link by email. If it doesn't arrive in a few minutes check your spam folder — and tell me if it's still missing.

entries.q: Can I change my email address?
entries.a: Our team can do that for you. I'm passing this on — mention the current address and the new one you'd like.

entries.q: I want to talk to a person
entries.a: Passing you to our support team now — they'll reply to the email address on your account. They're around Monday to Friday, 10am to 6pm IST.

entries.q: I'd like to suggest a feature
entries.a: Passing it to the product team — requests from working clinicians genuinely shape what gets built next.

entries.q: Can I call someone?
entries.a: You can reach the team on +91 92745 57987, Monday to Friday, 10am to 6pm IST. I'm also passing this conversation to them so they have the background before you call.
